column1: # No nvs_keys partition: that's only needed for ESP-IDF's Flash-Encryption-
# based NVS key protection scheme. This project uses the HMAC-peripheral
# scheme instead (the Kconfig default on ESP32-S3
# peripheral) — confirmed by an actual build; see src/storage/nvs_storage.c
# and sdkconfig.defaults' NVS encryption comments for the full story.
